note: Photographic slots are built from assets/photos/ by scripts/build_photos.py, which writes an AVIF and a JPEG at each responsive width and rewrites the w, h, widths and source fields below to whatever the photograph could honestly deliver after cropping. Nothing is upscaled. The remaining artwork slot is generated by scripts/build_images.py. Alt text is content rather than decoration, so it travels with the slot and not with the file, and it describes what is actually in the frame. The photographs are stock and reference imagery, not field photographs, so no caption names a place.
